name: Goedel-Pset-v1
description: Goedel-Pset-v1 is a dataset of 1.64 million formal mathematical statements converted from natural language problems, used for training automated theorem proving models. The related Goedel-Pset-v1-solved dataset contains formal proofs for over 800K statements, enabling evaluation of formal proof generation capabilities.
reputation: A large-scale synthetic formal-math dataset used in theorem proving research, with growing interest but not yet a universally established benchmark.
notes: Includes large-scale formalized math problems and proofs; open-sourced datasets and models; surpasses prior state-of-the-art on miniF2F and PutnamBench.
